scope: Construction, kernel ablations and succession; root integrates frontier, opportunity search and commercial results separately.

claims.claim: A working bounded temporal-predicate compiler emits executable reference behavior and synthesizable Verilog. The two-predicate demonstration uses 29 state bits and 73 generic cells.
limits: Generic synthesis only; no technology-mapped area, power or physical timing.
Measured local compilation is not measured human engineering time or model inference cost.

claims.claim: Fresh main confirmation passed all 768 traces across 24 specifications, 52 directed actual-RTL cases, 14 invalid-request checks and 28 bounded equivalence checks.
limits: Equivalence is bounded under explicit reset, not a proof of every physical or software layer.
Independent workstreams shared a model family and campaign; not a blinded external laboratory.

claims.claim: The conventional implementation tied on functional acceptance and was faster in the measured Python replay workload.
limits: Single local runtime environment; no isolated hardware throughput comparison.
This defeats a broad candidate-speed or exclusive expert-agent advantage claim.

claims.claim: Physical timing, calibration, optics, instrument efficacy and vendor-link integration were not established.
limits: No measured Fmax, power, real photon data or programmed FPGA is supplied.

claims.claim: Predeclared operator removals violate selected functional contracts: early acceptance permits a later-veto false positive; pooled groups cross-trigger; a disconnected virtual link removes the downstream decision.
limits: Postconfirmation diagnostic with deliberately chosen traces, not a random failure-rate estimate or blinded causal agent experiment.
The no-veto early-accept control differs in decision time while preserving match existence.

claims.claim: Removing our compiler while retaining competent conventional RTL preserves all six selected outcomes. Our implementation is not necessary for the offered functional outcome.
limits: Semantic necessity for a specified contract does not establish implementation novelty, human-unforeseeability or newly feasible commercial value.

claims.claim: A frozen predecessor artifact was retained unchanged while a new acyclic-network grammar and wrapper made a prior decision usable as a virtual event after one logical clock delay. The predecessor rejects that grammar.
limits: New composition wrapper and grammar, not learned weights or autonomous scientific feedback.
Construction report is the preserved development snapshot; later confirmation evidence is in the separate confirmation report.

claims.claim: Fresh successor confirmation passed 48 traces across six networks, with 10 directed cases and nine invalid networks checked.
limits: Digital functional composition only, with explicit reset and one-clock interface.

claims.claim: Competent conventional network delivery and an ordinary library containing the byte-identical retained artifacts tied with the successor. Learned-specialist or economic compounding superiority is not established.
limits: Functional reuse may still be useful; it does not imply above-library specialist learning.

claims.claim: Successor extension and retained-asset costs are an additional US$4,100 planning estimate, charged once and not presumed financed by commercial surplus.
limits: Human effort allocations and inference costs are planning estimates, not observed invoices.
No downstream revenue or asset uplift offsets this option cost.
